newsitem.title: USA: U.S. defense chief to bone up on Trojan War.
newsitem.headline: U.S. defense chief to bone up on Trojan War.

text.p: On a break from running the world's most advanced military, Defence Secretary William Cohen plans to read a new translation of the Iliad, Homer's epic about the ancient Trojan War.

The Iliad, which describes the great 10-year war between forces from Greece and defenders of the city of Troy, "is one of the best books about battle descriptions every written," Ken Bacon, Cohen's spokesman, told reporters at the Pentagon on Thursday.
"There are riveting descriptions of battles," he added.
Bacon said Cohen, a published poet and spy novelist, would take the Iliad with him on vacation at an undisclosed spot later this month.
